book.name: 2 Tesalonaika
book.title: 2 Tesalonaika Tesalonaikanindva Puerati Vriv, Mendeklina Prolmba Mendah.

content: Kava honi, kav Pol, Sailas, Timoti, novol vipimbinna honamba tombaiva yem Kristusnindm domba Tesalonaikakotaramba, yimba doa nihra pepavena Sesoaina arainda, eva mendekli Yesus Kristusinda.
Ara Sesoa, eva mendekli Yesus Kristus, heoa yemoa undalm vewol evevra, wo osva yimba undwonamangasm wohavra.
Polva Naengho Vrevna Sesoana Helmhola Vewolalm Indhanam.

Seh, kava elsus wonowolohmanav Sesoamba, osva lehra yeindamba. Wo kaoa os velohra, manara noinda, memba hevm lehrangas besal. Temba lehra besal, manara noinda, osra yenamba keknamba undnahonamba almba, doa esvema suwemsna otavra kilihinv. Wo osoa yena vei, und avramana, pev ten nona avm indkumbi, wo pev ten vinvm mongnindmba Kristusnindm nona, eva doa esvema kelspranata.

Wo noindata kava yemba wivewol euvmona vevta, osva no Kristusnindna kembella kembella. Kava nom ishomana vinv, ona, himba wohviluwulkovna, keknamba almba undnahonamba os. Yemba mindnam sahonam indkokla vrevna, wo snavema kinmba oprinvna yemba. Wo heva os yimba lo bombothoprana, keknam undnahonam alm.

Honamba memba novnam nonglalm, osm Sesoava wohvev, helmhola vewolalmba indhanamba. Sesoava yemba indva vrinv, ishunilm, osm yeoa kana nemeltindira saivo. Yenamba kinmba dom prinv, kilihalm no nemeltindiram.
Wo Sesoava si vevav nomba, osva ora, memba besal, helmhola vewolalmba. Himba si kinmba daswolvav henomba, himba nomba temba yemba kinmba deiswilvnamba.

Wo himba si daswolvav, eha vewuvulmba vuhemba pina undmba, vera yem, eva kam. Sesoava si daswolvav honamba kolvrowolva, nonam mendekli Yesus hevm ambara vithinvram pim senamini hevna ovsongolnindnahonam, noi ten suwenanovna avm.
Himba si provav suwenahonam senaminiva, hindm nom kinm holothunilm, ten henoi ahnam lovahwolvm Sesoamongo. Wo osoa hev vei, engivmoa besalnemelmomba pivna mendekli Yesus Kristusnamba.
No indhanamba kinmba si os vreivav, wo si hemba yunalm wohindkokla vilovav. Himba si owaimomolmba nihrava pepavevavmoa mendekliindava, wo himba si puehalla wohlovahvav mendeklina pusambanakambara.

Honamba si no nambainam vevav, nonam mendekli Yesus provram, nambalm nom, hind men avm beswonamangas honana hevtindim. Hevtindiva si os hemba okulivav, manara, himba doara hemba undnahonamba amnavnamba. Himba si holvoreivav englisra hemba, indk vithimnivra. Wo yimba si di hemongo pepavevav, manara noinda yimba undnahonam amnavna, nomba temba kava eishunvnamba manam manam yemba.

Osrata kava elsusva yemba sembayang vewulvuhinv. Kava osahalvohmanav pivna Sesoam, yem kolvrowol velm, beswonam alm, os hev ten yem kekaiv venam, alm osm. Ten pev avm besalwevsana, noi yemba wohmoh vewol ovov manam manam velmba besalmba, wo yena pevna undnahonam yemba wohmoh owol vev, andra vihawolalmba. Kava sembayang vivna, osm hevnana himba si kolvrowol vevra yemba, manam manam velmba esvemava.

Kava sembayang vewuvmonav honamba, nom osm nihilva pivna mendekli Yesus Kristusnamba okulimnivra yeindava. Wo osoa eva himba okolowol vevra yemba. Nomba okolava phov wavrara pivna Sesoanamini, eva mendekli Yesus Kristusnamini.
